42| # Requests for files and pages pass through three stages:
43| #   1. get_rendered(): decides whether to serve plain data or render a Template
44| #   2. get_localized(): selects the localized variant of a Resource
45| #   3. Resource.get(): gets a Resource from the datastore or from a file
46| #
47| # When a request is served by a dynamic handler, the handler prepares some
48| # template variables and then renders the template using the same four stages.
49| #
50| # Suppose that a static image file '/global/logo.jpg' is requested, the current
51| # language is 'ru', and there is a Resource entity with key name 'logo.jpg' in
52| # ResourceBundle '1'.  The expected sequence of calls is as follows:
53| #
54| # request for static image, action='logo.jpg'
55| # > get_rendered('logo.jpg', 'ru')
56| #   > get_localized('logo.jpg', 'ru')
57| #     > Resource.get('logo.jpg:ru', B)  # B is <ResourceBundle '1'>
58| #       > Resource.get_by_key_name('logo.jpg:ru', B) -> None
59| #       > Resource.load_from_file('logo.jpg:ru') -> None
60| #     > Resource.get('logo.jpg', B)
61| #       > Resource.get_by_key_name('logo.jpg', B) -> R1
62| #     > LOCALIZED_CACHE.put(('logo.jpg', 'ru'), R1)
63| #   > RENDERED_CACHE.put(('logo.jpg', 'ru', None), R1.content)
64| # > self.response.out.write(R1.content)
65| #
66| # Suppose that a static page '/global/faq.html' is requested.  Assume there is
67| # a localized 'faq.html.template:ru' resource in Russian and a non-localized
68| # template file at 'resources/base.template', and all the caches are initially
69| # empty.  Due to the settings in django_setup.py, resources.TemplateLoader will
70| # handle template loading.  The expected sequence of calls is as follows:
71| #
72| # request for static page, action='faq.html'
73| # > get_rendered('faq.html', 'ru')
74| #   > get_localized('faq.html', 'ru')
75| #     > Resource.get('faq.html:ru') -> None
76| #     > Resource.get('faq.html') -> None
77| #   > get_localized('faq.html.template', 'ru')
78| #     > Resource.get('faq.html.template:ru')
79| #       > Resource.get_by_key_name('faq.html.template:ru', B) -> R2
80| #     > LOCALIZED_CACHE.put(('faq.html.template', 'ru'), R2)

83| #     > TemplateLoader.load_template('base.html.template')
84| #       > get_localized('base.html.template', 'ru')
85| #         > Resource.get('base.html.template:ru')
86| #           > Resource.get_by_key_name('base.html.template:ru', B) -> None
87| #           > Resource.load_from_file('base.html.template:ru') -> None
88| #         > Resource.get('base.html.template')
89| #           > Resource.get_by_key_name('base.html.template', B) -> None
90| #           > Resource.load_from_file('base.html.template') -> R3
